pages.observation: Reading order: (1) top-left caption 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' over a wide shot of the clinic entrance (doctor in white coat welcoming an older woman in a lilac sari, two patients waiting on chairs); (2) bottom-left panel, left balloon 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...'; (3) then 'I wish everything were easier to manage!'. Both balloons have tails to the receptionist (blue kurta, braid), who is on the phone and writing in a ledger. (4) Bottom-right panel: 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.' Its tail goes to the doctor, who stands with her hand at her chin, with the receptionist small in the background. Speakers are clear and tails point to the right people. No lettering covers a face, hand or prop. Small issues: 'Our time belongs with patients' reads a little unnatural in English ('belongs with our patients' or 'should go to patients' would be clearer). The doctor's last line answers the receptionist, but she is looking off to the side, not at the receptionist, so the reply is only implied by position. No problem with time or place.
